title: Stay on 30A Property Management: 30A Unplugged in Inlet Beach – Stay on 30A
meta_description: Stay on 30A Property Management: 30A Unplugged in Inlet Beach. Boardwalk to Lake Powell! Sleeps 8-Lake, Firepit, Bikes
description_expanded: class="property_description"> Welcome to '30A Unplugged' , professionally managed by Stay on 30a! This one-of-a-kind lakeside retreat is intentionally designed with no Wi-Fi and no TVs, inviting you to slow down, unplug, and fully reset. Tucked away on a quiet dead-end street, the home boasts 65 feet of private Lake Powell frontage, overlooking the largest coastal dune lake in North America. Calm waters, abundant wildlife, and wide-open views create a peaceful backdrop you’ll feel the moment you arrive. Start your mornings on the screened-in porch with a hot cup of coffee and birdsong in the air, no screens, no rush, just you and the view. Adventure and relaxation live side by side here. Spend your days paddle boarding across glassy water, casting a line with the provided fishing poles, or unwinding in the home’s private sauna after a long day outdoors. Explore the nearby trails at Camp Helen State Park, bike along scenic 30A, or head to the beach just 0.7 miles away for a sun-soaked afternoon. Inside, the home is warm, inviting, and thoughtfully designed with an open-concept layout that brings everyone together. The kitchen, dining, and living spaces flow seamlessly perfect for cooking meals, sharing stories, playing games, and enjoying uninterrupted time with the people who matter most. Evenings are best spent outside under the stars, wrapped in good conversation and total calm. This isn’t just a stay it’s a true digital detox. No Wi-Fi. No TVs. Just intentional living, deeper connection, and the freedom to be present. When you’re ready to explore, you’re just minutes from the dining, shopping, and charm of 30Avenue, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach close enough for fun, far enough to keep the peace. **Please note there is a home being built next door, and construction may still be occurring.  HOME HIGHLIGHTS: -Dock to Lake Powell -Total Unplugged Experience **No wifi or tvs** -Sauna -4 Paddle Boards -Fire Pit -4 Adult Bikes -Screened In Patio  -4 Driveway Spaces -Front Porch With Seating -Full Washer & Dryer -Lakefront **WHAT WE OFFER** A STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM AMENITIES: Body Wash | Shampoo | Conditioner | Hand Soap | Toilet Paper | Dish Soap | Dishwasher Pods | Laundry Detergent | Paper Towels | Trash Bags | Dish Sponge | Bath Towels | Bed Linens | WELCOME BUNDLE: Coffee Grounds | 2 Keurig Pods | Popcorn | Olive Oil | Fiji Water PARKING Four parking spaces available (4 driveway). No street parking allowed. Included is 4 bicycles (adult) for your convenience.  ACCOMMODATIONS: 30A Unplugged comfortably accommodates up to 8 people: FIRST FLOOR:  -Bedroom 1: King, Ensuite Bathroom  SECOND FLOOR: -Bedroom 2: King, Ensuite Bathroom -Bedroom 3: King, Shared Bathroom  -Bedroom 4: King, Shared Bathroom HOUSE RULES *Check-In: After 4PM | Check-Out: Before 10AM *Must be 25 years of age to book. Guests under 25 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian that is staying on premises. *No Smoking: Smoking is strictly prohibited including back porch/deck.  *No parties or events.  LOCATION Home is located in Inlet Beach - A coastal community just 0.7 miles away from Inlet Beach access points and less than five minutes to the heart of Rosemary Beach. It's located near the new, upscale shopping and dining center - 30Avenue, and close proximity to Rosemary Beach. The home is also just a short drive to Publix grocery store. This neighborhood is a mix of full/part-time residents and vacation rentals. It's very quiet and friendly! NEARBY BEACH ACCESS Inlet Beach has several beach access options to choose from. Below are the 3 most popular: -Inlet Beach Regional Beach Access: This access has parking, restrooms, and lifeguards during peak season. Located at the end of South Orange Street about 200 yards south of US Hwy 98. Inlet Beach Regional Access is the largest county access and features three dune walkovers and 117 parking spaces. Located 0.8 miles from house. -Wall Street Beach Access: Located about a mile drive from the Preserve at Inlet Beach, about 200 yards east of the intersection of US 30A and Highway 98, at the end of South Wall Street, where it dead ends at the gulf. NOTE: This Access has no public parking. There is no parking but there is parking, along with restrooms and outdoor showers about 1/4 mile east at the Inlet Beach Access. -Winston Lane Public Beach Access: Located less than .08 away. This access is on the western border of Inlet Beach where it meets Rosemary. There is not public parking available, but plenty of bike racks if you choose to ride a bike. IMPORTANT PRIOR TO ARRIVAL All guests will be required to sign a rental agreement, as well as provide a valid ID that matches with the name of the person that made the reservation which includes: 1) a photo of your government issued ID such as a driver’s license and 2) a "selfie". Both should be uploaded to our Happy Stays app. read more + less -
